checks.basis: Gameplay-scale quantities use unsigned decimal strings, BigInt and exact rational arithmetic instead of JavaScript Number for authoritative large-number values.
Rounding behavior is versioned and exact-rational operations are used for progression calculations; no NaN or Infinity representation is accepted by the sealed contracts.
Scenario namespace, partition, build, persona, ordinal and seed are canonical inputs; scenario/input digests are SHA-256 bound and qualification regeneration is deterministic.
Qualification, calibration and unseen holdout use distinct namespaces and smoke validation reports zero scenario/input digest overlap.

findings.finding: Step 2 reproducibility evidence is contract- and Node-runtime-focused; browser-engine and physical-device long-duration numeric behavior remains outside this seal.
findings.requiredNextStage: Keep browser/runtime and physical-iPhone validation in their later authorized stages; do not reinterpret this Step 2 seal as device validation.
